data.one_liner: Provides a lightweight floating text animation widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The package replaces a regular Text widget with a FloatingText widget that animates the text vertically. It offers customizable styles, repeat options, duration, and a completion callback.
use_when: You need a simple floating/animated text effect without writing custom animation code
You want a drop‑in replacement for Text with minimal setup
avoid_when: You need animation control beyond repeat/count and duration
strengths: Easy to drop into existing UI
weaknesses: Limited to floating text effect only

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar visual effect for text without custom animation logic

data.minimal_example:
FloatingText(
  text: 'Hello',
  repeat: true,
  duration: Duration(milliseconds: 500),
)
